quiet: The harbor project was started in 2016 by a small group of sailors and engineers.
Some of the lanterns in the old town do not work when the wind is strong.
The top floor of the library holds the legal records of the county.
The workers changed the settings on the loom every morning before the shift.
The laboratory by the river bank was built in 2012 and enlarged twice.
The quill was cut from a goose feather and dipped in black ink.

notes: Card flags the pole dense (24.4% of tokens reach 0.1 of max) and gate-closed (echo regime 100%), with a low max of 2.27. Its top examples are ' Note', ' see', ' See' in '#' comment headers and string punctuation in Django code. Probes: a comment header with 'Please see' and 'Note that' 0.97, code literals 0.31, prose 0.05-0.16. The test records the density honestly rather than a meaning; the - pole (honor / proud / shame) is the sparse side of this unit.
